maintenance_led.reason: Asset management fees on mutual funds, ETFs and institutional strategies; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees paid by individual and institutional investors through funds, ETFs and managed accounts, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Multi-boutique asset manager growing mainly via fund sales and distribution; only occasional affiliate additions, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Investors can redeem funds and move to other managers easily; no retraining or regulatory requalification needed.
